title: One boat, five letters: ب ت ث ن ي

bigIdea.text: Five letters share the same boat-shaped body. Only the dots tell them apart.

proper.text: ب (ba) has one dot below. ت (ta) has two dots above. ث (tha) has three dots above.
ن (nun) has one dot above and, standing alone, a deeper round bowl. ي (ya) has two dots below and, standing alone, a curling tail.
In the middle of a word all five can look like a small tooth with dots, so always count the dots and check above or below.
Sounds: ba like 'b', ta like a light 't' (tongue tip on the gum ridge), tha like 'th' in 'think', nun like 'n', ya like 'y' in 'yes'.

memoryHook.text: One below = b, two above = t, three above = th.

extras.text: Persian/Urdu readers: ث is a real 'th' here, not an 's' sound.

listen.note: Teacher reading of the single letters (mapped by lesson order; mark the segment for each letter when you watch).

drills.prompt: Say each letter with a fatha: بَ تَ ثَ نَ يَ

tip.text: ث: tongue tip lightly between the teeth, air flows ('th'). س: tongue behind the teeth, a hiss ('s').
ت is a stop: the tongue touches and releases. ث flows: air keeps going between tongue and teeth.

questions.q: Which letter has three dots above?
explain: shin also has three dots, but on a different body (the s-shape).

questions.q: How do you tell ب from ي in the middle of a word?
options: Count the dots below: one is ba, two is ya
You can't; they are the same letter
explain: Right: in the middle both are a small tooth; the dots decide.
Size is not reliable in joined writing.
They are different letters with different sounds.

questions.q: Which English sound is closest to ث?
explain: Right: a soft 'th' with air flowing.
That voiced 'th' is closer to ذ.

questions.q: Standing alone, which letter of this family has a curling tail?
explain: Right: ya ends with a tail and has two dots below.
nun has a deeper round bowl and one dot above.
ba is a flat boat with one dot below.
ta is a flat boat with two dots above.

questions.q: A Persian/Urdu reader often says ث like 's'. What fixes it?
options: Let the tongue tip touch the edge of the teeth and let air flow
Press the tongue on the roof of the mouth
explain: Lips are not used for ث.

questions.q: Which pair has the SAME number of dots?
explain: Right: both have two dots — above for ta, below for ya.

questions.q: Which letter of this family has ONE dot ABOVE?
Why should you never guess these letters from shape alone in the middle of a word?
options: Because all five share one body there; only dots differ
Because they have no dots in the middle
Because the Quran writes them differently each time
explain: The script is consistent; the dots carry the difference.

questions.q: ت is pronounced with the tongue tip on…
options: the gum ridge behind the upper teeth

questions.q: Which is the best memory hook for ب ت ث?
options: One below = b, two above = t, three above = th
Big = b, tall = t, thick = th
Left = b, right = t, middle = th
Red = b, green = t, blue = th
explain: Position in the word does not decide.

remnote: ث dots == Three dots above (tha, like 'think')
taskNow: Say بَ تَ ثَ نَ يَ three times, record the third time, then press Play mine (step 5, Practise) and compare it with the reference.
